summary: First test iteration for Caça-Palavras Tech. Backend /api/scores endpoints (POST, GET, root) and validation (empty name, seconds<1) all pass. Frontend validated end-to-end: grid 16x16 (256 cells) renders with all uppercase letters, pointer-drag selection marks words found (cells turn green, word-item line-through, counter increments, explanation modal with correct label/info opens and closes), reverse-drag selection works, clicking a found word re-opens its explanation, hint button adds 10s to timer and highlights a cell with amber ring, new-game regenerates a different grid and resets counter/timer, leaderboard modal opens via Ranking button. Backend tests also verify Mongo _id is excluded from responses and name is uppercased on save.
critical_code_review_comments: generator.js tryPlace: boundary check does not validate ec >= 0 (only ec >= size). For diagonals with dc = +1 this is fine, but still safer to add the lower bound.
App.js: VictoryModal is given key={game.grid[0].join('')} to reset name state across games — works but relies on grid uniqueness; a random key or useEffect reset in modal would be more explicit.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider lifespan context managers.
CORS defaults to '*' which is fine for dev; consider tightening for prod.
seed_data_creation: Test scores inserted with TEST_ prefix (TEST_ALICE, TEST_FAST, TEST_SLOW, TEST_MID). Cleaned up via module-scoped pytest fixture after the test module ran (delete_many on name regex ^TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_scores.py performs its own TEST_-prefixed cleanup via pymongo at module teardown. The full-victory flow (all 25 words -> victory-modal -> save-score-button -> leaderboard-modal with leaderboard-item-0) was not exhaustively drag-tested but each component (modals, save endpoint, leaderboard rendering) was verified individually; the save->list->sort path is covered by backend tests.
